claims: Manage hypotension with ongoing norepinephrine infusion and titrate vasopressor support to maintain adequate mean arterial pressure.
Monitor blood pressure closely (arterial and non-invasive) and assess response to vasopressor therapy.
Replete potassium given hypokalemia (serum 3.3–3.8 mEq/L, whole blood 2.3 mEq/L) with IV potassium chloride and monitor levels.
Monitor renal function and urine output given elevated creatinine (1.7–1.8 mg/dL) and BUN (39–45 mg/dL).
Assess and manage respiratory status with supplemental oxygen (O2 flow 10 L/min, FiO2 80%) and monitor oxygen saturation and arterial blood gases.
Continue stress ulcer prophylaxis with docusate sodium and consider acid suppression as indicated.
Monitor blood glucose and manage hyperglycemia with insulin as needed (glucose 112–144 mg/dL).
Monitor hemoglobin and hematocrit for signs of bleeding or anemia (hemoglobin 13.1–14.4 g/dL).
Assess and manage pain with multimodal analgesia (hydromorphone, oxycodone-acetaminophen, acetaminophen) as needed.
Maintain venous thromboembolism prophylaxis with mechanical or pharmacologic methods as appropriate.
